# Appropriation Ordinance No. 03, Series of 2017

**Supplemental Budget #03 — P764,000 from Savings (Personal Services)**

Resolution No. 002 | Special Session at Vice-Mayor's Office

## Summary

Appropriation ordinance enacting Supplemental Budget No. 03 for FY 2017, totaling **P764,000.00** sourced from savings under Personal Services. Enacted during a Special Session held at the Vice-Mayor's Office on December 26, 2017. Introduced by Coun. [[Adam M. Forbes]].

Absent during the session: [[Esperanza A. Tan]] and [[Carlos T. Gliane II]].

## Key Provisions

- **Total Supplemental Appropriation:** P764,000.00
- **Source of Funds:** Savings from Personal Services
- **Session Type:** Special Session
- **Session Venue:** Vice-Mayor's Office

## Entities

- [[Sangguniang Bayan]]
- [[Municipality of Pitogo]]
- [[Adam M. Forbes]] — introduced the ordinance
- [[Esperanza A. Tan]] — absent
- [[Carlos T. Gliane II]] — absent
- [[Paulino S. Sayat]] — Municipal Mayor
- [[Dexter L. Sayat]] — Vice Mayor / Presiding Officer

## Legal Basis

- [[Sec-316-RA7160]] — General limitations on the use of provincial, city, and municipal funds
- [[Sec-321-RA7160]] — Changes in or supplemental budgets
- [[Sec-336-RA7160]] — Use of appropriated funds and savings
